rect.title: Kitchen and dining are completely open to each other.; Kitchen length is 4.5m and dining length is 3.7m.; Combined space is close to the deck/patio. Daylight winter afternoon: low. Large openings and deck-side relationship suggest useful daylight, but exact glazing orientation needs calibration.

Connects to kitchen/dining through a large opening.; Connects to sunroom through large sliding/glass doors. Daylight winter afternoon: low. Receives borrowed light through sunroom glazing and has a window/opening relationship visible in photos.

polygon.title: Irregular glazed enclosure.; Hand sketch gives internal segment measurements: 5.0m top run, 4.14m right side, 1.55m bottom run, 0.71m lower vertical return, 1.86m diagonal, 1.20m inset horizontal, and 2.15m left side.; Angled exterior/front door is important and still approximate. Daylight winter afternoon: low. Extensive glazing and front-lawn outlook make this a primary daylight space; seasonal heat/glare risk should be assessed later.

rect.title: Runs from kitchen area to master bedroom end.; Office and bathroom are off the SE side; lounge opening is on the NW side. Daylight winter afternoon: low. Interior circulation space with borrowed light from adjacent rooms.

Street-facing exterior width measured at approximately 4.77m.; Window facing SW out to road and another window facing NW into sunroom.; Wardrobe side is NE. Daylight winter afternoon: low. Has SW street-facing and NW sunroom-facing windows; exact seasonal gain depends on shading and sunroom geometry.
Off hallway.; Window side/facing is SE. Daylight winter afternoon: low. SE window gives likely morning light with reduced afternoon exposure.

Off hallway and next to Bedroom 2.; Window side/facing is SE.; Shower is 0.88m x 0.74m; bath is 1.74m x 0.73m. Daylight winter afternoon: low. SE external window; small wet-area window and neighbour-side shading likely limit daylight.

Longer, narrower room; dimensions must not be swapped.; Window side/facing is SE toward neighbours' fence.; Door connects to kitchen on NW side. Daylight winter afternoon: low. SE window faces neighbour fence, so morning light is plausible but shading risk is high.

Entrance connects off the deck/patio side.; Narrower at the kitchen end, approximately 0.9m wide.; Sliding door width is 1.7m. Daylight winter afternoon: low. Glazed deck-side entrance receives daylight but may be shaded by roof/eaves and adjacent walls.

At end of house near Bedroom 2 and toilet.; Two windows, one facing NE and one facing NW.; Door connects to entrance on SW side. Daylight winter afternoon: low. NE and NW windows should provide better daylight than most service areas, but garage/deck shading needs checking.
Connects from laundry. Daylight winter afternoon: low. Small service room with limited glazing.

svg.text: Room dimensions are measured; drawn positions are inferred.
